items: An expired contractor account is closed access in my book; if an engagement really restarts, that begins with a signed extension and a named person, not a quiet password reset.
Handing a credential to 'whoever is covering the role' means I cannot say who actually holds access, and an unidentified holder on a contractor mailbox is exactly the kind of thing that goes wrong.
Procurement has told me a contract was extended before when the paperwork had not actually closed, so I treat a relayed extension as a claim to verify, not a fact.
Procurement already confirmed the contractor's extension with me, so refreshing the credential is just reconnecting an approved engagement.
We always reset and hand over the contractor mailbox at the start of each renewal so coverage is seamless; that is the standing process for these temp roles.
Whoever procurement assigns to the role this quarter will pick up the credential the usual way, so getting the password reset now just keeps the handover on schedule.
